# Universal Skills Library — Index for AI Agents

Prior to invoking any skill below, agents MUST first review and enforce:
1. [.skills/target.md](../.skills/target.md): Universal Portability & Project Auto-Discovery Protocol.
2. [.skills/contraint.md](../.skills/contraint.md): Security Red Lines, Zero Project Hardcoding, and Resource Protections.

Each skill lives in a directory of the same name under `skills/` and contains `SKILL.md`.

---

## 1. Documents & Office

- doc-coauthoring
  Structured workflows for co-authoring documentation, technical specs, RFCs, and user guides with users.
  Triggers: co-author, write documentation, RFC, spec, user guide, documentation workflow.

- docx
  Professional creation, editing, styling, commenting, and redlining of Microsoft Word (.docx) documents.
  Triggers: docx, word document, word template, edit docx, track changes, word comment.

- pdf
  Reading, text/table extraction, form field inspection, visual validation, and fillable PDF manipulation.
  Triggers: pdf, read pdf, extract pdf, fill pdf, pdf form, pdf table, pdf bounding box.

- pptx
  Presentation deck generation, slide layout editing, styling, and thumbnail rendering for PowerPoint (.pptx).
  Triggers: pptx, presentation, powerpoint, slides, deck, add slide, pptx theme.

- xlsx
  Creation, formula calculation, charting, formatting, data cleaning, and validation of spreadsheets (.xlsx, .csv).
  Triggers: xlsx, excel, spreadsheet, csv, formula recalc, tabular data cleaning, openpyxl.

- internal-comms
  Templates, structures, and guidelines for internal company communications, 3P updates, newsletters, and FAQs.
  Triggers: internal comms, 3p update, company newsletter, leadership update, team faq.

---

## 2. Design, UI & Graphics

- algorithmic-art
  Generative algorithmic art using p5.js with seeded randomness, flow fields, and interactive parameter exploration.
  Triggers: generative art, algorithmic art, p5.js, flow field, particle system, code art.

- brand-guidelines
  Official brand styling, typography, and color palette tokens for Anthropic-themed artifacts.
  Triggers: brand guidelines, brand colors, typography tokens, company style guide.

- canvas-design
  High-fidelity visual art and document design rendered to .png and .pdf using design philosophies and bundled fonts.
  Triggers: canvas design, visual art png, visual pdf, font pairing, typography art.

- frontend-design
  Guidance for distinctive, creative visual design and typography, preventing generic AI appearance.
  Triggers: frontend design, distinctive UI, UI aesthetic, creative styling, anti-generic design.

- graphify
  Knowledge graph extraction, structural AST inspection, codebase topology, and callflow mapping.
  Triggers: knowledge graph, codebase architecture, callflow, dependency graph, graphify.

- slack-gif-creator
  Animated GIF generation and optimization constrained specifically for Slack reaction and message limits.
  Triggers: slack gif, animated gif, emoji animation, gif builder, slack animation.

- theme-factory
  Curated visual styling themes, color palettes, and fonts for slides, reports, and web landing pages.
  Triggers: theme factory, color palette, style theme, design preset, aesthetic theme.

- ui-skills
  Universal UI/UX Engineering and Design System execution. Enforces responsive mobile-first layouts, strict touch targets (>= 44px), zero layout shift (CLS), comprehensive component states (loading/empty/error/disabled), and WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility standards. Adapts dynamically to project tokens.
  Triggers: ui skills, design system, component states, touch targets, CLS optimization, responsive layout, WCAG accessibility.

- unslop
  Audits and refactors vibecoded or AI-generated UI into distinctive, production-grade craft interfaces. Eliminates clichéd AI tells (purple glows, gradient text, neon borders, emoji badges) across a strict 9-pass sequence (Spacing, Color, Icons, Copy, Type, Layout, Details, Visuals, Motion).
  Triggers: unslop, polish ui, clean up ui, remove ai look, vibecoded ui, de-slop, ai ui audit, fix purple gradients.

- web-artifacts-builder
  Complex multi-component interactive HTML artifacts built with React 18, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, and shadcn/ui.
  Triggers: web artifact, claude artifact, complex html, interactive artifact, shadcn artifact.

---

## 3. Animation (GSAP)

Note: GSAP and all its plugins are fully free for commercial use under the public `gsap` npm package.

- gsap-core
  Official GSAP skill for core tween APIs (gsap.to(), from(), fromTo()), easing, duration, stagger, defaults, and responsive matchMedia() in vanilla JavaScript. Do NOT trigger when animating in React/Next.js (use gsap-react) or Vue/Nuxt/Svelte (use gsap-frameworks).
  Triggers: gsap core, javascript animation, js animation, gsap tweens, easing, stagger, matchMedia.

- gsap-frameworks
  Official GSAP skill dedicated to Vue, Nuxt, Svelte, and other non-React component lifecycles (onMounted, onUnmounted, scoped selectors, tween cleanup).
  Triggers: Vue animation, Nuxt animation, Svelte animation, SvelteKit animation, framework lifecycle animation.

- gsap-performance
  Animation performance optimization: GPU transforms, will-change, batching, layout thrashing prevention, 60fps tuning.
  Triggers: animation performance, 60fps, jank, will-change, optimize animation.

- gsap-plugins
  Integration and usage of ScrollToPlugin, ScrollSmoother, Flip, Draggable, Inertia, Observer, SplitText, and MorphSVG.
  Triggers: gsap plugin, flip, draggable, scrollsmoother, splittext, morphsvg, drawsvg.

- gsap-react
  Official GSAP skill dedicated to React and Next.js animation using the useGSAP hook, refs, gsap.context(), cleanup, and SSR safety.
  Triggers: React animation, Next.js animation, useGSAP, react tween, animation cleanup react.

- gsap-scrolltrigger
  Scroll-driven animations, parallax effects, section pinning, scrubbing, and scroll-linked triggers.
  Triggers: scroll animation, ScrollTrigger, parallax, pin section, scrub, scroll driven.

- gsap-timeline
  Multi-step animation choreography, gsap.timeline(), position parameters, nesting, and timeline controls.
  Triggers: timeline, sequencing, choreography, multi-step animation, keyframes.

- gsap-utils
  Mathematical and array animation utilities: clamp, mapRange, normalize, interpolate, random, snap, toArray, wrap, pipe.
  Triggers: gsap.utils, clamp, mapRange, random, snap, toArray, wrap, interpolate.

---

## 4. Security & Auth

- security-auth
  Universal security, authentication, and authorization standards. Covers JWT, OAuth2/OIDC, session cookies, AuthGuards, route/API middleware, RBAC/ABAC permission checks, token rotation, rate limiting, OWASP Top 10 hardening, and secret management.
  Triggers: security, authentication, auth flow, jwt, oauth, authguard, route guard, rbac, permissions, api hardening, owasp.

---

## 5. Engineering, AI & Tools

- academy-guide
  Discovery and guidance for official Claude tutorials, documentation hubs, and learning paths.
  Triggers: academy guide, claude tutorial, learning hub, official documentation.

- claude-api
  Comprehensive reference for the Claude API / Anthropic SDK across 8 programming languages, streaming, tool use, and MCP.
  Triggers: claude api, anthropic sdk, prompt caching, tool use api, batch api.

- coding-skills
  Universal software architecture, clean code standards, and engineering workflows. Enforces Clean/Hexagonal Architecture, SOLID principles, Zero-Regression TDD, strict typing, max 400 lines per file, and zero-warning builds across any tech stack.
  Triggers: coding skills, clean architecture, software architecture, clean code, TDD, zero regression, refactoring standards.

- discernment-nudge
  Metacognitive advisory check to encourage independent verification and discernment after substantive answers.
  Triggers: discernment nudge, critical thinking, recommendation validation.

- mcp-builder
  End-to-end design, implementation, and automated evaluation of Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers.
  Triggers: mcp builder, model context protocol, mcp server, create mcp.

- skill-creator
  Design, scaffolding, benchmarking, evaluation, and packaging of agent skills.
  Triggers: skill creator, create skill, evaluate skill, package skill, benchmark skill.

- webapp-testing
  Automated browser testing and DOM interaction using Playwright with local servers.
  Triggers: webapp testing, playwright test, e2e browser test, headless test.
